content.title: RR vs RCB Live Score, IPL 2026 - Sooryavanshi, Jurel star as Rajasthan Royals stay unbeaten
content.text: RR won by 6 wickets (with 12 balls remaining)Apr 10, 2026, 1:32 PMJurel hits the winning runsHe finishes 80 not out off 42 balls as Royals chase down 202 with two overs left. This is Jurel's highest score in all T20s. No alarms in the end for them despite a brief flutter, Jadeja and Jurel have calmly seen this home.Apr 10, 2026, 1:06 PMJurel marches on25 Balls taken by Dhruv Jurel to bring up a half-century, his second of the season. RR on track.Apr 10, 2026, 12:53 PMRCB since the start of the 9thRR broke a 24-ball boundary drought when Jadeja got a thick inside edge off Krunal Pandya to the fine leg boundary. Krunal has single-handedly helped drag the asking rate to seven an over with seven overs remaining.Apr 10, 2026, 12:46 PMKrunal strikes, albeit a tad late?Sooryavanshi flat-bats him to long-on first, and then Shimron Hetmyer casually deflects the ball, as if he's giving catching practice, to short third. Riyan Parag then averts the hat-trick, but RR are well on their way home. 132/3 in 9 overs. The asking rate is below seven an over with 11 overs remaining.Apr 10, 2026, 12:29 PMI'm in it too, says Jurel97 - the highest powerplay score so far this season. Royals well and truly on their way. Abhinandan Singh's two overs have cost 40.Apr 10, 2026, 12:22 PMAnother night, another Sooryavanshi fiftyAnd he’s done it again - a 15-ball half-century, matching the mark he set against CSK, brought up with back-to-back sixes off Bhuvneshwar Kumar.The first is brutal, a cross-batted bludgeon over long-on. The second isn’t quite as convincing - the ball climbs on him, he commits to the pull, gets a top edge...but it still sails over deep backward square. Phil Salt settles under it, only to realise he’s beyond the ropes.Royals 73/1 in 5 oversApr 10, 2026, 12:17 PMSooryavanshi v HazlewoodNo prizes for guessing who’s nudging the singles and who’s dealing in boundaries.Apr 10, 2026, 12:14 PMAbhinandan's expensive startSooryavanshi plunders 16 in the over, signing off with a Jayasuriya-esque whip over square leg for six. RR are up and running at 37 for 1 in just three overs. One thing is already clear: Sooryavanshi isn’t changing a thing. He’s taking them on the only way he knows.Apr 10, 2026, 12:11 PMHazlegod is backAnd how!After being tonked for two sixes, he goes cross-seam into the pitch and has Yashasvi Jaiswal nicking off to Jitesh Sharma behind the stumps. Interestingly, five of the six deliveries were back of a length.RR 21/1 in 2 oversApr 10, 2026, 12:04 PMSooryavanshi off in a flashRCB try to cramp him for room, with Bhuvneshwar Kumar bending one back in late with a near-yorker. Somehow, Sooryavanshi digs it out first ball and shovels it straight back past the bowler for four.A couple of swishes later, he finishes the over in style by lofting the last ball over cover-point for another boundary.RR 9 for 0 after the first overApr 10, 2026, 11:49 AMVenkatesh makes cameo 29*The two overs after Patidar’s dismissal - 17 to 19 - yielded just 14, leaving RCB needing a surge to breach 200.They get exactly that. Venkatesh Iyer tears into Sandeep Sharma in the final over, plundering 20 runs, capped off with a towering six over long-off to finish.RCB surge to 201 - it's game on.Apr 10, 2026, 11:32 AMPatidar's fireworksApr 10, 2026, 11:24 AM#RaPa to RCB's rescueHe was on 20 off 22, with wickets falling all around him.Three overs later, he has raced to 50 off 35.And one of the reasons for this surge is his surety in stroke-making. The two sixes he hit off Burger in the 15th had that stamp of authority. A gentle extension of his arms to loft one cleanly over long-off laid down the marker, but the hop back to whip a short ball aimed at his ribs over deep square leg was the blockbuster.Apr 10, 2026, 11:17 AMRCB activate their Impact PlayerVenkatesh Iyer walks into a full-blown crisis on RCB debut. He's been subbed in for Devdutt Padikkal.RCB’s original Impact Player plan was clearly Suyash Sharma, but a batting collapse - they're 125 for 7 in 14 overs - forces a rethink. They need runs.So in comes Venky, drafted in as batting insurance, joining his MP teammate and close friend Patidar in the middle. And the reason why he's in the middle is because Shepherd top-edged a slog off Jadeja to short fine leg.Apr 10, 2026, 11:13 AMRomario time12 The first six of RCB's innings comes in the 12th over as Romario Shepherd lofts Bishnoi cleanly over long-off. Incredibly, it's off the first ball he faces.Apr 10, 2026, 10:57 AMRCB continue to collapseHe traps Jitesh Sharma lbw with one that skids low in his first, and has Tim David heaving a slower length ball down long-on's throat off his second. RCB are in deep, deep trouble. 94/6 in 11 overs.So who is Brijesh Sharma?At 27, he's no spring chicken. He was determined to come up the ranks in J&K - he hails from Udhampur. When cricket didn't take him far in his home state, he moved to Delhi to train at the Unique Sports Club on the recommendation of his state senior, Vivrant Sharma (who briefly played for Sunrisers Hyderabad).From there, he moved east to Bengal, where he made a name at the Bengal Pro T20, where he picked up 11 wickets in seven matches for Sobisco Smashers Malda.Apr 10, 2026, 10:35 AMBishnoi's double puts RCB in troubleTwo overs, two big strikes.He nearly had Patidar lbw as he misjudged a slog sweep in his first, only for the angle to save him. But Bishnoi would've taken that if he was told he'd get Kohli a few balls later. And it is a gem. Tossed up, beautifully disguised in the air, drifting in before dipping late as Kohli swings through - completely deceived, and bowled all ends up.In his second, he gets Krunal Pandya who hits one flat to long-off, where Hetmyer pulls off a stunner. And just like that, the man who lost his place to Digvesh Rathi at LSG last year, is making amends and is proving to be one of the early bowling MVP contenders.RCB in need of a repair job, 73/4 in 8 overs.Apr 10, 2026, 10:33 AMKohli lays into SandeepSandeep Sharma had the wood on Kohli, having dismissed him seven times in 18 innings coming into this game. In this period, Kohli had hit Sandeep for 132 runs with a strike rate of 150. It was always likely the two would have another new-ball duel in the powerplay, and Kohli has won the first exchange hands down by thumping him for two authoritative boundaries - lofted imperiously over mid-off and driven sumptuously through extra cover.Apr 10, 2026, 10:25 AMArcher strikes back after Kohli surgeTwo of the three boundaries are carved expertly between point and short third, Kohli making Archer’s pace work for him. The other is pulled to fine leg, even if Kohli may have been a touch hurried.And after being picked away for the boundaries, Archer has a second wicket, with Padikkal miscuing a flick down towards long leg, where Shimron Hetmyer takes a superb catch diving forward.Frenetic scenes in Guwahati. RCB 45/2 in 3 overs.Apr 10, 2026, 10:22 AMUnlucky BurgerNandre Burger has already produced two absolute jaffas to Kohli. On another night, he might have had him twice. The first draws him into a push and zips past the outside edge; the second sneaks past the inside edge and swings viciously, evading even a full-length dive from Jurel to run away for four byes.In between, Kohli unfurls that trademark whip over square leg, and there’s a wayward burst of five wides for good measure.RCB are purring: 32 for 1 after just two oversApr 10, 2026, 10:11 AMSalt v ArcherIt takes a vicious, rip-roaring bouncer to undo RCB’s powerplay enforcer. The ball flies off Phil Salt’s glove before he can even sway out of the way, looping gently to Dhruv Jurel, who completes a simple catch behind the stumps. There’s precious little Salt could’ve done - sometimes you just have to doff your hat and acknowledge a superb delivery.It's an eventful first over. Apart from Salt's wicket, Archer nearly had Kohli off the last ball as he nicked a lifter past a diving Jurel. Just prior to that, Padikkal picked off two boundaries, one off a genuine outside edge past the slips and another delightful cut over backward point.Apr 10, 2026, 9:58 AMUpdate:If there's no further rain, we'll start at 8.40pmApr 10, 2026, 9:26 AMLooking ahead to the big clashRajasthan Royals opt to bowl v Royal Challengers BengaluruBig drops of rain returned just as the toss neared its completion, with the ground staff swiftly bringing the covers back on. For the record, Riyan Parag won the toss as Rajasthan Royals elected to bowl first against RCB in a battle of two unchanged sides in Guwahati's final game of IPL 2026.Parag cited rain and moisture on what should've otherwise been a dry surface as one of the reasons behind his decision. Royals left out Tushar Deshpande for fellow-seamer Brijesh Sharma in their bowl-first XI. with Vaibhav Sooryavanshi set to come in as the Impact Player.]Rajat Patidar announced the return of Josh Hazlewood for RCB, following a swift recovery and a fitness clearance from Cricket Australia. This means Jacob Duffy, who performed exceedingly well in the two games prior to this, has to make way."We've been clinical before the start of the tournament. We want to play smart cricket. Hope we keep assessing and adapting," Parag said. "All three games are in the past, we have to perform. If we don't, we'll lose two points."This is RCB's first away game, following two excellent home wins at the Chinnaswamy to kick off the season. Last year, they won each of their seven 'away' fixtures en route to the final, where they beat Punjab Kings to be crowned champions for the first time.Rajasthan Royals (Playing XI): Yashasvi Jaiswal, Dhruv Jurel (wk), Riyan Parag (capt), Shimron Hetmyer, Donovan Ferreira, Ravindra Jadeja, Jofra Archer, Nandre Burger, Sandeep Sharma, Ravi Bishnoi, Brijesh SharmaImpact subs: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Lhuan-dre Pretorius, Ravi Singh, Shubham Dubey, Tushar DeshpandeRoyal Challengers Bengaluru (Playing XI): Virat Kohli, Philip Salt, Devdutt Padikkal, Rajat Patidar (capt), Jitesh Sharma (wk), Tim David, Romario Shepherd, Krunal Pandya, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Abhinandan Singh, Josh HazlewoodImpact Subs: Suyash Sharma, Jacob Bethell, Rasikh Salam Dar, Kanishk Chouhan, Venkatesh IyerApr 10, 2026, 9:11 AMIn better news for RCB:Josh Hazlewood is warming up. It remains to be seen if he's gonna start tonight. The signs are promising. We were earlier told he'd be available from mid-April. We'll find out in 15 minutes if he does startApr 10, 2026, 9:07 AMIn some more reading:Apr 10, 2026, 9:05 AMStart time decidedCovers beginning to come off. The Super Sopper is doing its duty. Players of both sides have started to warm-up. Some confirmation coming in: Toss at 8.00pm, start time of 8.15pm. Full game.Apr 10, 2026, 8:40 AMThe duel that was worth the waitApr 10, 2026, 8:20 AMThe making of Vaibhav SooryavanshiIf you missed it earlier: I travelled to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi’s hometown this month to trace the roots of his remarkable rise. What I found were some incredible stories from those who’ve known him since he was 6 or 7. There’s also his mentor, Zubin Bharucha, breaking down the nuances of his technique and what sets it apart. It’s a long read, but I’d love to know what stands out to you about the 15-year-old.Apr 10, 2026, 8:16 AMThe rain is backAnd so are the covers. We're looking at a delay. For now, only the square has been covered, but the pitter-patter is rather steady. Just a matter of time before they bring on additional covers. Looks like we're in for a frustrating evening. Forecasts change and how. Last evening, the forecast for today was clear from early afternoon. And yet here we are, bracing for delays.Apr 10, 2026, 7:43 AMPitch and conditionsTrue pitch, even bounce, and conducive for strokeplay. It's the same surface on which RR walloped 150 in their 11-over shootout against Mumbai Indians (MI) on Tuesday. The mantra will pretty much be the same for the batters: plant the foot forward, flay the ball fearlessly. The weather forecast seems a lot better too, from around start time.Apr 10, 2026, 7:14 AMRain stops, covers starting to come offGood news, guys. The rain has relented. The centre strip is still covered but all other covers have been removed. A Super Sopper is going around doing its work.Apr 10, 2026, 6:36 AMRaining in GuwahatiThe news from the centre isn't great: it's raining heavily in Guwahati. Earlier this week, the Rajasthan Royals vs Mumbai Indians game was reduced to 11 overs a side. Let's keep our fingers crossed.Apr 10, 2026, 6:19 AMTeam news?RR are likely to remain unchanged; there are no injury concerns in their camp.Rajasthan Royals (likely XII): 1 Yashasvi Jaiswal, 2 Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 3 Dhruv Jurel (wk), 4 Riyan Parag (capt), 5 Shimron Hetmyer, 6 Donovan Ferreira, 7 Ravindra Jadeja, 8 Jofra Archer, 9 Sandeep Sharma, 10 Nandre Burger, 11 Tushar Deshpande, 12 Ravi BishnoiHazlewood is still working his way back to full fitness and remains an unlikely starter. The only other decision for RCB is whether to persist with Abhinandan Singh, which seems likely. If they opt for a change, however, Rasikh Dar and Mangesh Yadav are two viable options.Royal Challengers Bengaluru (likely XII): 1 Virat Kohli, 2 Phil Salt, 3 Devdutt Padikkal, 4 Rajat Patidar (capt), 5 Tim David, 6 Jitesh Sharma (wk), 7 Romario Shepherd, 8 Krunal Pandya, 9 Bhuvneshwar Kumar, 10 Jacob Duffy, 11 Abhinandan Singh, 12 Suyash SharmaApr 10, 2026, 5:54 AMBattle of two unbeaten teamsIn the days leading up to IPL 2026, the conversation around Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) and Rajasthan Royals (RR) revolved around valuations, ownership, and their much-talked-about changes of owner. Within weeks, though, the focus has shifted to on-field performances and the excitement these two sides have caused. Their all-win record seems almost incidental.If Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has brought the box-office appeal, Devdutt Padikkal has matched it with the purity of his strokeplay and a high-tempo presence at No. 3. Yashasvi Jaiswal and Dhruv Jurel's authority at the top has been mirrored by Rajat Patidar's remarkable six-hitting, while Nandre Burger's pace and late swing have found an echo in Jacob Duffy's relentless hard lengths. And this is without even mentioning Virat Kohli - an ever-present force at the top, whose evolving approach has now carried into a third straight season.RCBRR100%50%100%RCB InningsRR InningsOver 18 • RR 202/4RR won by 6 wickets (with 12 balls remaining)Instant answers to T20 questions
